title: PR Closed workflow: pull_request_target close handling cancels runs, then deletes PR-scoped caches via refs/pull/<N>/merge
answers: Why are GitHub Actions caches from a closed or merged pull request still present, and how do I remove them?
Where is the workflow that cancels runs when a PR closes handled, and which job does what?
How do I add another cleanup step (for example, deleting artifacts) to the on-close workflow without giving write access to every job?
Why does the delete-caches job only target the merge ref and not branch caches?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/pr-closed.yml (workflow "PR Closed", formerly cancel.yml) runs on pull_request_target types closed. The `cancel` job cancels workflow runs tied to the PR, and the dependent `delete-caches` job (needs: cancel) runs `gh cache delete --all` for the PR's merge ref.
Rule: Cache cleanup on PR close is scoped to `refs/pull/${PR number}/merge` only, passed via env PR_NUMBER and REPO from github.event.pull_request.number and github.repository. Keep the job-level `permissions: actions: write` on the job that deletes caches, not at workflow top level, and keep `--succeed-on-no-caches` so a PR without caches does not fail the job.
Constraints: Use ubuntu-slim with timeout-minutes 5 as in the existing job. Do not widen the --ref filter to branch refs or to all caches; this job is meant only for PR-merge-ref caches. Changes to other close-time cleanup should be added as separate jobs with their own minimal permissions. Does not apply to the workflow runs that trigger on pull_request (non-target) events.
applies: Repository GitHub Actions workflows that react to pull request close/merge and manage caches or runs for that PR.
says: Build caches from closed or merged pull requests are not getting deleted automatically.
Workflows attached to a pull request keep running even after it is closed.
Closing a pull request without any stored cache causes the cleanup job to fail.
Ensure cache deletion upon pull request closure is limited strictly to merge caches.
Avoid granting write permissions to the entire pull request closure workflow.
search: In .github/workflows/pr-closed.yml, closing a pull request triggers workflow cancellation via the cancel job followed by merge-ref cache deletion in the delete-caches job. Cache deletion uses gh cache delete --all scoped strictly to refs/pull/${PR_NUMBER}/merge via PR_NUMBER and REPO environment variables, including --succeed-on-no-caches and job-level actions: write permissions. The job must use ubuntu-slim with a 5-minute timeout without widening the --ref filter to branch refs or all caches, keeping additional cleanup steps in separate jobs with minimal permissions. This workflow applies solely to pull_request_target closed events, not to pull_request events.
